request.style: English, male baritone solo, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, soft strings, moderate piano, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What did you go to the wild to see
A reed shaken by the passing wind
Or a man in soft and costly clothes
Those who wear such splendor dwell in palaces
But what did you go there to find
A prophet, yes, and far more than that
Behold, I send my messenger ahead
Who will prepare your way before you

[Chorus]
No one born of women is greater than John
Yet the least in the kingdom is greater than he
This generation is like children in the square
Calling out to one another in vain

[Verse]
They sat in the marketplace calling out
We played the flute and you did not dance
We sang a dirge and you did not weep
John came eating no bread or wine
You said he has a demon within
The Son of Man came eating and drinking
You said a glutton and a drunkard
A friend of tax collectors and sinners

[Chorus]
No one born of women is greater than John
Yet the least in the kingdom is greater than he
This generation is like children in the square
Calling out to one another in vain

[Bridge]
Tax collectors acknowledged God's justice there
For they were baptized with John's baptism
But Pharisees rejected God's purpose for themselves
Since they had not been baptized by him

[Outro]
Yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children
Wisdom is vindicated by all her children
